name: Invention disclosure brief for patent counsel
summary: Before the first call with patent counsel, the founder or engineering lead has one factual brief: the invention in the inventor's words, who contributed what and when, every outside demonstration, sale, talk or publication with its date and audience, and the records still missing. Counsel decides.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own rules for legal preparation: the organisation's own records as the only authority, every statement quoted and located, every gap written as a question, and a named lawyer who decides and signs.

sources.contribution: Getting the inventor's account in one round, covering what was made, how, by whom and when, and each kind of outside showing or offer by name; starting from an existing disclosure form; ending with the facts still open.
